most_thrilling.name: Most Thrilling
most_thrilling.body: End the game farthest along the Thrill track.
most_thrilling.details: Ties are broken as they are during the Bonuses step: the player whose emotion disc is on top is considered farthest along.
most_thrilling.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.

most_awesome.name: Most Awesome
most_awesome.body: End the game farthest along the Awe track.
most_awesome.details: Ties are broken as they are during the Bonuses step: the player whose emotion disc is on top is considered farthest along.
most_awesome.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.

most_joyful.name: Most Joyful
most_joyful.body: End the game farthest along the Joy track.
most_joyful.details: Ties are broken as they are during the Bonuses step: the player whose emotion disc is on top is considered farthest along.
most_joyful.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.

out_of_this_world.name: Out of This World
out_of_this_world.body: End the game with at least 3 Sci-Fi attractions.
out_of_this_world.details: The six attraction types are Souvenir, Old West, Sci-Fi, Undersea, Fantasy and Prehistoric.
out_of_this_world.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.

primitive.name: Primitive
primitive.body: End the game with at least 3 Prehistoric attractions.
primitive.details: The six attraction types are Souvenir, Old West, Sci-Fi, Undersea, Fantasy and Prehistoric.
primitive.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.

fantastic.name: Fantastic
fantastic.body: End the game with at least 2 Fantasy attractions.
fantastic.details: The six attraction types are Souvenir, Old West, Sci-Fi, Undersea, Fantasy and Prehistoric.
fantastic.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.

rough_and_wild.name: Rough and Wild
rough_and_wild.body: End the game with at least 2 Old West attractions.
rough_and_wild.details: The six attraction types are Souvenir, Old West, Sci-Fi, Undersea, Fantasy and Prehistoric.
rough_and_wild.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.

most_drenched.name: Most Drenched
most_drenched.body: End the game with at least 3 Undersea attractions.
most_drenched.details: The six attraction types are Souvenir, Old West, Sci-Fi, Undersea, Fantasy and Prehistoric.
most_drenched.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.

most_variety.name: Most Variety
most_variety.body: End the game with at least 5 different attraction types.
most_variety.summary: At least 5 of the 6 attraction types.
most_variety.details: The six attraction types are Souvenir, Old West, Sci-Fi, Undersea, Fantasy and Prehistoric. Only one attraction of a type is needed for that type to count.
most_variety.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.

most_ecological.name: Most Ecological
most_ecological.body: End the game with 4 or fewer removed trees.
most_ecological.details: Counts the tree markers you removed from your property over the game, mostly with the Arborist action -- not the trees still standing.
most_ecological.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.

best_space_planning.name: Best Space Planning
best_space_planning.body: End the game with 6 or more removed trees.
best_space_planning.details: Counts the tree markers you removed from your property over the game, mostly with the Arborist action. The direct opposite of Most Ecological.
best_space_planning.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.

best_souvenirs.name: Best Souvenirs
best_souvenirs.body: End the game with at least 5 different concessions.
best_souvenirs.details: Concession tiles are the small tiles taken with the Contractor action. Different kinds count, not the total number of tiles.
best_souvenirs.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.

best_designed.name: Best Designed
best_designed.body: End the game with at least 6 covered icons.
best_designed.details: Counts the icons on your property boards that your placed tiles cover -- emotion icons, money icons and wild icons alike.
best_designed.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.

most_expensive.name: Most Expensive
most_expensive.body: End the game with at least 3 attractions on expansion boards.
most_expensive.details: Expansion boards are the boards bought with the Realtor action and added to the far-left or far-right of your property.
most_expensive.extra: 3 VP if satisfied at the end of the game.
